description.value: Fintech company that sells corporate cards, business banking accounts, expense tracking and spend-management software to businesses, mainly startups and tech firms.
Finance software platform that combines corporate cards, banking, expense management, travel, bill pay, and accounting automation.
San Francisco fintech that began as a corporate charge card issuer for startups and expanded into a broader financial suite.
Finance software platform that combines company cards, banking, expense management, and accounting.
American fintech company, now a subsidiary of Capital One, that provides business financial products to technology startups.

product_description.value: Corporate credit cards, business banking accounts, and expense tracking, with integrations to accounting and finance systems and an API.

Corporate cards with built-in spend controls, AI-driven expense management, in-app travel booking, AI-assisted bill pay, business banking and treasury (yields up to 4.36%), and accounting automation with ERP integrations.
Corporate card, Brex Cash cash management account, venture debt, Brex Empower spend management software, expense tracking and virtual accounts.
Corporate cards, expense management, travel, bill pay, banking and treasury, and accounting automation.
Credit cards, cash management accounts, and a spend management software platform; launched Brex Empower in 2022 to help employees follow expense policies.

business_model_description.value: Revenue comes mainly from card transaction fees (interchange); it may also earn interest on cash management accounts.
Revenue from interchange fees on card transactions and subscriptions (including Brex Premium); plans start at USD 0 per user per month, with advanced features at USD 12 per user per month (Preqin).

customer_description.value: Mainly startups and tech firms, spanning funded startups, mid-sized companies and enterprises.
Startups, mid-size companies and enterprises; the page cites 35,000+ top companies but names none.
Startups and high-growth companies, moving upmarket to enterprise; one source cites 20,000+ clients from small startups to large enterprises and names OpenAI as an enterprise customer.
Startups, mid-size companies and enterprises; trusted by 35,000+ companies.
Startups, especially venture-backed ones with limited credit history; since June 2022 focused on enterprise customers after exiting the small and midsize business market.

locations.value: South of Market, San Francisco (about 100,000 sq ft leased in 2025)
